reviews.text: I think that Scott has a lot of experience to share. So much of what he does is training the owner, which I knew going in. He really gives a lot of insights, and helpful hints based on experience.

Scott and Barbara are fantastic.  My wife and I really enjoyed and were impressed by Scott really taking the time to understand the details about our dog.  He gave some very honest input with the overall goal of helping us.  We would definitely recommend.

Scott at USA Dog Behavior is incredibly knowledgeable and was great to work with. What impressed us most was how he tailored his training approach specifically to the needs and personality of our dog rather than using a one-size-fits-all plan. His experience and understanding of dog behavior really show, and he gave us practical strategies that we could continue using at home. I would highly recommend Scott to anyone looking for an experienced, thoughtful, and effective dog trainer.

Scott and his dog training program have been amazing! He is funny and is very knowledgeable, patient, and truly knows how to work with dogs. I’ve seen a huge improvement and couldn’t be happier with the results. Scott takes the time to explain everything and makes the entire process easy to understand. I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a great dog trainer!
Great, effective, practical training - for our pup & for us!

Scott is truly a dog behaviorist. He listened to our concerns, assessed our dog's issues, came up with a working plan and explained everything very clearly.
Scott knows exactly what he's talking about; he gave the reasoning behind each strategy, including what the dog is thinking and what could go wrong if we did the opposite of his suggestion. Several of the dog trainers we had used in the past had given us incorrect information on how to handle our dog. Scott was good for us because he sent follow-up emails with information and more plans. He was kind and understanding, not judgmental.
Scott was fantastic helping us put lots of tools in the toolbox for my dog’s separation anxiety and made such a difference in only 3 visits. 10/10 highly recommended!

Honestly I was very disappointed in this, I was hoping this would be a more hands on approach to helping my dog’s aggression problem. I was only given the most basic of knowledge here, like i should leave my dog in a room and isolate him. I was hoping he would have some dogs around to help my dog, but no. For $400 for an hour to be told nothing but basic knowledge is a waste. I should have done more research before reaching out to scott, that is on me. Hope this helps any other people like me.

We had two sessions with Scott, and he went above and beyond answering every question and addressing all of our concerns. In less than 24 hours, our dog is already doing better! Scott is incredibly kind, clearly knows his stuff, and even shared some resource links that have been hugely helpful. He restored our confidence in our girl - her sense of security is growing, and her behaviors are improving both at home and on the leash. Thank you again, Scott!

Scott really knows what he’s talking about. He helped me understand my dog’s fears and anxieties. He provided a lot of information and exercises on how to help my dog. I see the improvements with my dog already. Scott really took the time to understand what issues I was having with my dog and came up with a custom plan. He does a great job with teaching the owner. I had a fantastic experience with Scott. I was afraid that my dog would always be fearful as nothing I did myself worked, but Scott was able to provide me with the education and tools to help my dog. I would definitely recommend him.

We had a fantastic experience with Scott from USA Dog Behavior.  He is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and clearly passionate about what he does. Our dog Woody responded so well to his positive training methods, and we saw real improvements in just a few sessions. Scott took the time to tailor the approach to our dog’s specific needs and made sure we felt confident continuing the training at home. Highly recommend!

Scott and Barbara were incredible with our dog, Ret! We had taken Ret to a few different board and train places in the past (and even did their refresher courses), but unfortunately some of the behaviors we were concerned about weren't getting any better. Scott quickly helped us get to the root of Ret's issues, and we saw noticeable progress in Ret's fear-based aggression towards other dogs within just a few sessions with Scott (he even gave us super helpful at-home training tips and exercises to work on between meetings and to continue Ret's training after our last session). My wife and I would highly recommend USA Dog Behavior to anyone looking for help diagnosing and training their dog!

His expertise is unparalleled and given with the utmost kindness and compassion. Barbara set the tone going into the process and put our fears to rest. Thank you Scott and Barbara!!
